title: Probing the Trajectories of Reasoning Traces in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.23163v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly solve difficult problems by producing reasoning traces before emitting a final response. However, it remains unclear how accuracy and decision commitment evolve along a reasoning trajectory, and whether intermediate trace segments provide answer-relevant information beyond generic length or stylistic effects. Here, we propose a trajectory-probing protocol for evaluating how a reasoning model's predicted answer evolves along a partial reasoning trace. The protocol (1) generates a model's full reasoning trace, (2) truncates it at fixed token-percentiles, and (3) injects each partial trace back into the model, measuring the model's induced answer distribution. We apply the protocol to seven open-source reasoning models (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, gpt-oss-20b/120b, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B and Gemma-4-31B-it) across four benchmarks (GPQA Diamond, MMLU-Pro, Omni-MATH-2 and CompMath). translated_title: 探测大语言模型推理轨迹的演变路径
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地通过在给出最终回答之前先生成推理痕迹来解决困难问题。然而，准确率和决策确定程度如何沿推理轨迹演变，以及中间推理片段能否在泛泛的长度或风格效应之外提供与答案相关的信息，目前仍不清楚。在此，我们提出了一种轨迹探测协议，用于评估推理模型的预测答案如何沿着部分推理轨迹逐步演变。该协议包含三个步骤：(1) 生成模型的完整推理痕迹，(2) 在固定的 token 百分位点处将其截断，(3) 将每个部分推理痕迹重新注入模型，测量模型由此产生的答案分布。我们将该协议应用于七个开源推理模型，涵盖四个基准测试（GPQA Diamond、MMLU-Pro、Omni-MATH-2 和 CompMath）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种轨迹探测协议，通过截断推理模型的中间推理痕迹并回注入模型，来测量预测答案分布沿推理轨迹的演变，从而揭示推理过程中准确率与决策确定度的动态变化规律。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a trajectory-probing protocol that truncates and re-injects partial reasoning traces to measure how a reasoning model's predicted answer distribution evolves along its reasoning trajectory, evaluated across seven open-source reasoning models and four benchmarks.
